title: Surreal Attic Symphony
description: A hairless cat with glasses sits on a stool in a purple attic, writing musical notes with a pencil. Behind it, a giant green skull with red and blue sunglasses contains glowing potion bottles while two skeleton figures in robes stand on a red spiral rug to the left.
prompt: A surreal scene inside a purple attic with a skylight showing a sunset. A hairless sphynx cat wearing round glasses sits on a black stool writing sheet music with a yellow pencil. Behind the cat is a giant green skull with glowing red and blue sunglasses, its mouth open to reveal shelves of colorful glowing potion bottles. To the left, two skeletons in black robes stand on a red spiral rug, one holding papers. On the right, translucent purple figures play a saxophone, a drum, and an acoustic guitar. Scattered sheet music, feathers, and small bottles cover the dark floor. Mystical and whimsical atmosphere.
